title: AutoFix Jira Context
description: Stage 6: the normalized, validated task context read directly from a live Jira issue (parse-jira-context.py output, after validate-jira-context.sh has approved it). This -- not any PostgreSQL snapshot -- is what build-agent-prompt.sh renders into the Copilot CLI prompt.

descriptionText.description: Full Jira description, converted from Atlassian Document Format to plain text.

status.description: Current Jira workflow status name (e.g. OPEN). Must not be Done/Closed/Cancelled for the ticket to be eligible.

projectKey.description: Must equal AUTO for this POC.

approvedComments.description: Only comment bodies beginning with the [AUTOFIX_AGENT_CONTEXT] marker, with the marker stripped. All other Jira comments are untrusted and are never forwarded to Copilot.

autofixContext.description: Parsed AUTOFIX_CONTEXT_V1 JSON block embedded in the Jira description by Workflow 02, or null if the ticket does not carry one (which validate-jira-context.sh treats as INVALID_JIRA_CONTEXT).

stackTrace.description: Truncated to 12000 characters by Workflow 02, with a '...[truncated]' marker appended if the original was longer.

autofixContextError.description: Present only if an AUTOFIX_CONTEXT_V1 block was found but failed to parse as JSON.
